items.name: Please Be Quiet Auckland 2025

venue.name: 1st Mount Albert St Jude's Scout Hall

items.information:
Please Be Quiet Auckland 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.
​
This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.
​
Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
​

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2025
items.information:
Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar och inofficiella grenar!

Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com/competitions). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on Side Events and Unofficial Events!

Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

This competition will also include Unofficial Events, rules and results can be found at [Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com/competitions). Read more under the tab Unofficial Events.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
